path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis target; relative paths are rejected.

format.description: Explicit interpretation: dos-com or raw-binary (headerless), gamecube-dol (GameCube/Wii DOL, never auto-detected), or esp-flash-image (an ESP flash dump read with flash_offset and partition_table_offset). Omission preserves header-based detection.

architecture.description: Caller-supplied CPU family. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. format=gamecube-dol takes powerpc from the header, so it must be omitted.

entry_point.description: Caller-supplied load and entry address (0xhex). File offset 0 is mapped here. Required with format=raw-binary; rejected otherwise. Optional with format=gamecube-dol; must equal the DOL header entry.

flash_offset.description: Flash address (0xhex) of the dump's first byte, when it does not start at flash address 0. Only with format=esp-flash-image.

partition_table_offset.description: Flash address (0xhex, a multiple of 0x1000) of the partition table, which disables the table scan. Only with format=esp-flash-image.

provider_id.description: Exact deep-analysis provider ID, or automatic selection when omitted.

snapshot_path.description: Absolute local filesystem path for the analysis snapshot; relative paths are rejected.

open_binary.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

detail.description: Start with summary (default): it keeps open state, the binding, current-route capabilities (including selected Ghidra checkpoint mode), each provider candidate's selection source, availability and target-support status, code and reason with its rejection codes, and every tool's availability, reason and remediation; omitted_fields lists what it leaves out. Request complete only when you need unavailable-candidate remediation, provider or rejection diagnostics, candidate capabilities or static tool surface, effect and annotation flags.

max_input_bytes.description: Stable input byte admission; does not raise report or parser budgets. Default 268435456. Positive safe integer, maximum 9007199254740991; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_report_bytes.description: Complete normalized Go report byte admission; independent of MCP response delivery. Default 8388608. Positive safe integer, maximum 536870888; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_build_info_bytes.description: Aggregate embedded Go build-info string bytes, including compiler version and framed module text. Default 1048576. Positive safe integer, maximum 402653166; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_header_search_bytes.description: Cumulative Go build-info discovery bytes; overlapping search ranges consume work. Default 268435456. Positive safe integer, maximum 9007199254740991; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_string_literals.description: Maximum returned inferred strings; requires include_string_literals: true. Default 2000. Positive safe integer, maximum 9007199254740991; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_string_literal_bytes.description: Largest inferred string candidate in bytes; requires include_string_literals: true. Default 4096. Positive safe integer, maximum 536870888; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_string_bytes.description: Aggregate returned inferred string bytes; requires include_string_literals: true. Default 524288. Positive safe integer, maximum 9007199254740991; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_string_header_scan_bytes.description: Static string-header and candidate-byte scan work; requires include_string_literals: true. Default 67108864. Positive safe integer, maximum 9007199254740991; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

max_string_candidates.description: Distinct static string candidates tracked before projection; requires include_string_literals: true. Default 100000. Positive safe integer, maximum 9007199254740991; byte maxima reflect runtime Buffer/string representability including base64 expansion. Applies on the next inspection without restart.

source_paths.description: Exact relevant file paths from the artifact inventory, relative to the application root, analyzed in first-request order before unselected scopes; no globs or implicit dependencies. Omit to analyze all sources.

semantic_precision.description: Per-source evaluator budgets. Omitted fields preserve defaults: primitive_candidates 256, primitive_bytes 1048576, expression_depth 256, getter_expansions 512, alias_selections 512, wrapper_visits 1000000, wrapper_depth 128. Raising these does not raise graph retention, worker memory, transfer or parent result budgets; cyclic and unsupported values remain unknown.

max_semantic_nodes.description: Maximum retained semantic nodes across the application; defaults to 100000. Worker heap and parent result admission remain enforced.

max_semantic_nodes_per_file.description: Maximum retained semantic nodes per source file; defaults to 20000, additionally bounded by max_semantic_nodes and memory/transfer limits.

max_semantic_unknowns.description: Maximum retained semantic unknown records across the application; defaults to 100000. Omitted emission occurrences are counted by family and reason.

max_semantic_unknowns_per_file.description: Maximum retained semantic unknown records per source file; defaults to 20000, additionally bounded by max_semantic_unknowns and memory/transfer limits.

max_heap_mb.description: Maximum V8 old-space heap in MiB for the isolated JavaScript source analyzer; defaults to 1024. This does not change the CLI/MCP process heap. When REA runs on Bun, which ignores V8 heap flags, Windows instead limits the analyzer's committed memory to this budget plus a 512 MiB runtime reserve; other Bun hosts enforce no limit.

analysis_timeout_ms.description: Maximum startup, analysis and transfer time per JavaScript source, in milliseconds; defaults to 300000. On timeout, return collected partial Evidence and stop the analysis.
